title: Changelog from Commits
description: Turn one release's git history into user-facing release notes. Faithful lift of the 'changelog-generator' SKILL.md (by ComposioHQ, awesome-claude-skills, Apache-2.0): its six 'What This Skill Does' moves become an 8-node DAG. Scanning the history and reading the house style guide run in parallel; noise filtering gates categorization; breaking changes and security fixes get their own review lane because they carry obligations (upgrade steps, disclosure wording) that ordinary entries don't; the formatter joins all three; release blurbs fan out from the finished changelog.

scan_history.name: Scan History
scan_history.does: Pull every commit in the release range, normalized.

read_style.name: Read Style Guide
read_style.does: Turn the house style guide into concrete voice and format rules.

filter_noise.name: Filter Noise
filter_noise.does: Drop internal commits: refactors, tests, CI, chores, reverted work.

categorize.name: Categorize Changes
categorize.does: Group changes into features, improvements, fixes, breaking, and security.

review_breaking.name: Breaking & Security Review
review_breaking.does: Confirm breaking and security changes; write upgrade and disclosure notes.

translate.name: User-Friendly Rewrite
translate.does: Rewrite each change as a plain-language user benefit.

format_changelog.name: Format Changelog
format_changelog.does: Assemble the release section in house format, then lint it.

release_blurbs.name: Release Blurbs
release_blurbs.does: Derive app-store, email, and social copy from the changelog.

deliverable.description: User-facing release notes (CHANGELOG.md) with upgrade and security notes, ready-to-post release blurbs, plus the filter log that shows which commits were left out and why.
